care.interrupted: Care visit could not be completed

interrupt.scope_mismatch: Help asked for is outside the agreed tasks
interrupt.medical_concern_escalated: Medical concern: 112 or a doctor contacted

plans.title: Recurring plans
plans.body: Recurring care plans (repeating days, shift series and renewals) are not available yet. They stay switched off until scheduling and the care policy are approved. Each care booking covers one agreed time only, and nothing renews automatically.

gated.scheduler_and_policy_not_approved: Waiting for scheduling and care policy approval.

scopeNote: Caregivers provide non-clinical help only. They do not give medicines, injections, wound care or any medical treatment.

dashboard.title: Care overview
dashboard.description: Work for {name}. Every number comes from current records.

services.title: Services and rates
services.description: The help you offer and your prices. Prices are fixed when a request is made.
services.emptyBody: Services added during onboarding appear here after they are saved.

staff.title: Caregivers
staff.description: Caregivers in your agency, their skills and verification. Each caregiver only sees their own assignments.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: Caregiver availability is not connected yet. It will come from availability rules and existing reservations once scheduling is approved.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Care requests for your agency. Accept only with a verified caregiver who covers every requested task; nothing is accepted automatically.
requests.acceptBody: Choose a verified caregiver whose skills cover every requested task.
requests.noEligible: No verified caregiver covers all these tasks.
requests.accepted: Accepted. The care visit has been scheduled.
requests.declineBody: The family is told the request was declined. Choose the reason.
requests.declined: Declined. The list has been updated.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Agreed care visits. Caregivers see only their own; agency managers see the agency's.
assignments.confirmBody: The time is recorded by the server, not your device.
assignments.interruptBody: The visit ends and the agency is told. If anyone is in danger, call 112 first.
assignments.done: Saved. The list has been updated.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Check in and out for your shifts. Times are recorded by the server.
shifts.absentBody: The agency is told so they can arrange a replacement.
shifts.replaceBody: Choose another verified caregiver from your agency.
shifts.notEligible: That caregiver is not eligible for this shift.
shifts.done: Saved. The shift has been updated.
shifts.emptyBody: Shifts for your assignments appear here.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Care payments and settlements are not connected yet. Only delivered care will be billed, never a recurring charge.

support.title: Support
support.body: Support tickets for your care visits are not connected yet. In an emergency, call 112.
